title: Candidate phase-gate formulas vs frozen gate contract
status: CANDIDATE_TESTING — candidates are the defect-class formulas, not the Boolean reference
disclaimer: not_phase_candidate reproduces the documented failure signature (both inputs HIGH). and_phase_candidate_* reproduce the wave-logic bond gate W=w*cos(Delta_phi) with HIGH iff W>=0, which algebraically reduces to XNOR for the 0/pi encoding.

candidates.NOT_phase_candidate: always HIGH (failure signature from scoring_verdict transcript)
candidates.AND_phase_candidate_M1: HIGH iff cos(phi_a - phi_b) >= 0  => XNOR truth table
candidates.AND_phase_candidate_M2: HIGH iff cos(phi_a + phi_b) >= 0  => XNOR truth table (00,11 high; 01,10 low)
